_about: «قصص من السنة» in the steps of the starting path (reply 0036 part ب). Written by Talal after reviewing out/starter-stories-review.md; ids only, never a text. `steps` is keyed by a step id of web/src/config/starter-path.json (islam, allah, iman, pillars, shahada, salah, taharah, sawm, zakah, hajj). Each step: `stories`, HadeethEnc hadith ids in the order shown (1 to 12, no repeat); and optionally `chapters`, the ids of the HadeethEnc categories the stories were taken from (as in data/starter-story-cats.json), named on the card's source line by HadeethEnc's own titles (worker/src/config/hadith-categories.json). Every title, grade and takhrij comes from D1 by id. A story whose grade is not sahih or hasan is not shown (rule 10), and a chapter none of the shown stories belongs to is not named. A step absent here, or with no story shown, has no stories card. Example: "salah": { "stories": ["3185", "4968"], "chapters": ["464", "457"] }. Checked by worker/test/starter-stories.test.ts.
